note: 随机搜索得到的一组与目标不矛盾的参数；目标少、参数多，不是唯一解。
note_en: A parameter set found by random search that does not contradict the targets; with few targets and many parameters it is not unique.

targets.why: 有储户级数据的挤兑里，去取款的储户所占比例
targets.why_en: In runs with depositor-level data, the share of depositors who withdrew

targets.why: 熟人跑了，自己更可能跑
targets.why_en: A depositor is more likely to run once an acquaintance has
A correction works but leaves a residue

targets.why: 两家银行都在当局公开担保之后撑住了
targets.why_en: Both banks held once the authorities publicly vouched for them

targets.why: 丰川：每十个平行世界里至少有三个像史料那样——第 6 天前后起挤兑、少数人取款、担保后平息、金库不倒（三成的下限是这里定的）
targets.why_en: Toyokawa: at least three in ten parallel worlds resemble the record, with a run starting around day 6, a minority withdrawing, calm after the guarantee and the bank surviving (the three-in-ten floor is set here)

targets.why: 东亚银行：被提走的存款不到总额的 2%（主席事后的说法；银行公布的是 0.67%）。这个案例的结果已经看过，所以拿来校准、不再算检验
targets.why_en: Bank of East Asia: under 2% of deposits withdrawn (the chairman's later account; the bank reported 0.67%). The result of this case has been seen, so it is used for calibration and no longer counts as a test

targets.why: 一人说不信，两人说起疑，三人说就信了
targets.why_en: One man says it and is not believed, two and doubt sets in, three and it is believed
